text: TemplateTransfer's top-1 precision drops from 0.55 above 40% template identity to 0.41 below 30% identity.
quote: it reaches 0.55 top-1 pocket precision when template identity exceeds 40%, but precision drops to 0.41 for targets below 30% identity

text: MultiTempl's pooling raises recall by 0.15 over single-template transfer, but precision on low-identity targets stays flat because low-quality templates vote with equal weight.

text: ConsenSite's unweighted consensus across homologous structures gains 0.07 precision but requires multiple experimental structures of the target itself and was not evaluated on template-based transfer.
quote: It improves precision by 0.07 over single-structure scoring, but requires multiple experimental structures of the target itself
